name: BLACKJACK
description: Blackjack (also known as 21) is the most iconic casino banking game in the world. Players compete individually against the dealer to reach a hand value as close to 21 as possible without exceeding it (busting). Known for its combination of chance and mathematical strategy, it is the only casino game where a skilled player can systematically gain an edge over the house through basic strategy and card counting.

content.text: Blackjack (also known as 21) is the most iconic casino banking game in the world. Players compete individually against the dealer to reach a hand value as close to 21 as possible without exceeding it (busting). Known for its combination of chance and mathematical strategy, it is the only casino game where a skilled player can systematically gain an edge over the house through basic strategy and card counting.

Descended from the 17th-century French game 'Vingt-et-Un' (Twenty-One). The name 'Blackjack' originated in American gambling halls that offered a special 10-to-1 payout for an Ace of Spades and a black Jack (Spades or Clubs).
Typically 1 to 7 players seated at a semi-circular table, all playing against a central Dealer.
Standard 52-card French decks (usually 6 or 8 decks in a shoe).
Casino table, chips, card shoe, discard tray.
After bets are placed, players and the dealer receive two cards each. Usually, one of the dealer's cards is face up (upcard) and one is face down (hole card).

items.text: Spanish 21: Played with 48-card decks (10s removed). Offers various bonus payouts for specific 21 combinations.
Blackjack Switch: Players play two hands and can switch the second cards dealt to each hand.
